feed.title: World News - Breaking international news and headlines | Sky News

articles.title: Garda investigation launched as two bodies found in Ireland
articles.summary: A Garda investigation has been launched after two bodies were discovered in Ireland.

articles.title: At least 153 people killed in drone strike on disputed Sudan-South Sudan region
articles.summary: A drone strike on a fuel depot in a disputed region on the Sudan-South Sudan border has killed at least 153 people.

articles.title: Man arrested in Pakistan over $126m counterfeit postage scheme
articles.summary: A man has been arrested in Pakistan and accused of running a counterfeit postage operation costing the US Postal Service $126m (£94m).

articles.title: Uganda reacts angrily as Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case
articles.summary: Nigeria has recorded its first case of Ebola during the current outbreak, the country's health ministry has said - as the virus continues to spread internationally.

articles.title: Swimmer killed in shark attack in South Africa
articles.summary: A 65-year-old woman was killed in a shark attack at a popular beach on South Africa's southeastern coast, local authorities said.

articles.title: Suspect arrested in France after fire at historic city hall
articles.summary: A man has been arrested after a fire at the town hall of Limoges, according to French media.

articles.title: Four soldiers from UN-backed force missing after gang attack in Haiti
articles.summary: Four soldiers from El Salvador are unaccounted for after being attacked by heavily-armed gangs in Haiti.

articles.title: Albanians set fire to government buildings and clash with riot police in latest protests
articles.summary: Demonstrators in Albania have set fire to government buildings and banks, smashed shop windows during the latest clashes with police as they demand the prime minister's resignation.

articles.title: Australian MP hit by car has both legs amputated as suspect appears in court
articles.summary: An Australian MP hit by a car has had both of her legs amputated, her husband has said.

articles.title: Trump's approval rating hits new record low as US midterms loom
articles.summary: Donald Trump's approval rating has fallen to a record low - indicating that next month's midterm elections could be punishing for the Republicans.
